0.name: TEXT_REGNOR4EZEL_00644_EZELII_000_000
0.description: My mind races, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>. If an illusory space such as Lyhe Mheg can exist, who is to say there aren't more? <snort>

1.name: TEXT_REGNOR4EZEL_00644_EZELII_000_010
1.description: Lest you wonder, my creator named me for their esteemed teacher, who was said to be a hermetic of unrivaled skill. I should like to meet them, but apparently they are no longer in Il Mheg.

2.name: TEXT_REGNOR4EZEL_00644_EZELII_000_020
2.description: Never have I seen such a delightful place! I'm giddy with excitement in spite of myself! <snort>

3.name: TEXT_REGNOR4EZEL_00644_EZELII_000_030
3.description: Those regions that remain sealed are rife─and ripe─with nightmares. <slurp> Tantalizing though they smell, I know I will regret devouring them...

4.name: TEXT_REGNOR4EZEL_00644_EZELII_000_040
4.description: Tyr Beq is in deep thought. This is highly uncharacteristic of a pixie, and I can't help but worry...

5.name: TEXT_REGNOR4EZEL_00644_EZELII_000_050
5.description: To not only lose a dear friend, but to know that perhaps their aether is responsible for all this... It must be very difficult for Tyr Beq.

6.name: TEXT_REGNOR4EZEL_00644_EZELII_000_060
6.description: An Lad becomes ever more unstable, and little wonder. The aether that forms them is too potent for a newborn pixie to bear.

7.name: TEXT_REGNOR4EZEL_00644_EZELII_000_061
7.description: If they continue to question their own existence, the nightmare in their heart will grow and grow until it consumes them entirely.

8.name: TEXT_REGNOR4EZEL_00644_EZELII_000_080
8.description: Pixies are simple beings. When faced with hardship, rather than fight it, it is said that they will simply abandon living altogether. I gravely fear that An Lad is on that course.

9.name: TEXT_REGNOR4EZEL_00644_EZELII_000_100
9.description: By my conjecture, the soul from which An Lad was born was no different from that of ordinary pixies.

10.name: TEXT_REGNOR4EZEL_00644_EZELII_000_101
10.description: The aether that quickened them, however, was far from ordinary─the aether of the fallen Titania. Based on their dreams of the castle, we may be certain of this.

11.name: TEXT_REGNOR4EZEL_00644_EZELII_000_102
11.description: Not so certain, however, is whether this union between aether and soul happened by chance or by design. The academic in me can't help but wonder, but I doubt that question shall ever be answered.

12.name: TEXT_REGNOR4EZEL_00644_EZELII_000_120
12.description: How did you like stepping into the dreaming world, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>? I for one found it highly enjoyable─and it was in no small part due to the fine company!

13.name: TEXT_REGNOR4EZEL_00644_EZELII_000_130
13.description: Dreams may be considered a reflection of the soul. And for good or ill, pixies are the simplest souls of all.

14.name: TEXT_REGNOR4EZEL_00644_EZELII_000_131
14.description: If a part of Titania indeed lives on in An Lad, I choose to believe that they have now found the peace they deserve.
